mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, category_id, unit, safety_stock, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM sku WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, category_id, unit, safety_stock, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM sku WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sku WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku (code, name, category_id, unit, safety_stock, enabled) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{categoryId}, #{unit}, #{safetyStock}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE sku SET name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, unit = #{unit}, safety_stock = #{safetyStock} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sku SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled != #{enabled}
